# Marky v1.8.11

Fixes the Linux AppImage icon.

### Linux

- The AppImage's `.DirIcon` was an absolute symlink into the build machine's directory, so it pointed at nothing once the AppImage was mounted. Tools that read the icon from inside the AppImage couldn't find it, and the AppImageHub catalog rejected the image. The build now uses Tauri CLI 2.11.5, which writes the link as a relative path (#47).
